items.stem: What is the key difference between a profile and a permission set in Salesforce?

options.rationale: Permission sets extend, they do not replace, the baseline from the profile.

options.text: A profile sets baseline access; permission sets grant additional access on top
options.rationale: Correct: profiles are the baseline and permission sets add incremental access.

options.text: Profiles can be assigned many per user
options.rationale: A user has one profile but can have many permission sets.

options.text: Permission sets control the login hours only
options.rationale: Permission sets grant a range of permissions, not just login hours.

items.explanation: Correct: profiles are the baseline and permission sets add incremental access.

items.stem: Which relationship should you use when child records must be deleted if the parent is deleted and inherit the parent's sharing?

options.rationale: Correct: master-detail cascades deletes and inherits sharing from the parent.
Lookup does not cascade delete or inherit sharing by default.
Hierarchical applies only to the User object.
External lookup references external data, not this scenario.

items.explanation: Correct: master-detail cascades deletes and inherits sharing from the parent.

items.stem: Select TWO tools an administrator can use to automate a record update when a field changes.

options.rationale: Correct: a record-triggered Flow can automate updates on change.
Reports display data; they do not automate updates.
Correct: an approval process can drive field updates as records progress.
Data Loader is for bulk import/export, not event automation.
Dashboards visualise data; they do not automate updates.
